title: Make AI argue against the decision you've already made
story: This has become one of my favorite uses of AI because—shocker—I can become very attached to my own idea.
"Do you think this is a good idea?"
That's basically begging an AI model to congratulate you.
I give it my decision and tell it:
prompt: Assume I'm wrong. Find the three assumptions most likely to make this fail. Tell me what evidence would change your conclusion.
after: The point isn't to let Claude run your life.
It's to force yourself to see the thing you stopped looking for the minute you decided what you wanted the answer to be.
